title: Applications of Reproducing Kernels in composition operators
summary: In this paper, we illustrate the effectiveness of reproducing kernel Hilbert space techniques in the study of composition operators. For weighted Hardy spaces on the unit disk, we characterize the composition operators whose adjoint is again a composition operator. Using reproducing kernel methods, we obtain a classification of bounded weighted composition operators acting between reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces.
